about_the_game:
Ghost Gang is a co-op beat’em up where you play as a ghost in a small town. Your power of possession is your greatest weapon against evil spirits taking over the town's residents. Use it to your advantage and save the town in your own way!
 

Power of Possession

Possess anyone or anything to battle the evil spirits. Each body has its unique skills that offer you different ways to win the fight. 

Your possessed body may die in battle, but as long as you manage to protect your soul and switch from body to body, there is never game over.  

Beat’em Up Combat

Take your enemies on in fast-paced beat’em up battles. Close the gap, strike hard, then dodge out before diving back in. Switch bodies on the fly for strategic move. Stay sharp, keep moving, and fight through the waves until you punched the last evil spirit out of the town.

Claim the Enemy’s Power

Evil spirits fight with the same possession powers as you. Once you defeat the enemy, you can then claim their body and abilities as your own, even bosses can be possessed once they’re beaten on the ground.

Play in Team

Facing evil alone won’t get you far. Join up to 4 players in local or online co-op. Call on your friends to revive you when your soul is defeated. Team up to coordinate different characters and merge your skills for powerful killing combos.
